meaning: Proposed unvalidated alternatives in scratch; the candidate engine was never installed or run. These are not changes made after the reported amendment-1 runs.
candidate_engine_changes: K4a/b: replace derivative Euler corrections with a constant-profile reparameterization before differentiation, using profile shapes in RADIAL_DATA.
Every-b solver: pivot first on the reference/mass equation when it contains squared flow; modify the zero-pivot domain and evaluate solved mass equalities.
K4c: construct xi_w as an offset plus a radial integral; differentiate the input profile, with a constant-profile mutation site instead of zeroing the gradient result.
Rename the metric angle from theta to s9b_theta.
Use radial_diff in the turning-point derivative so the derivative freezes reach it.
K10: negate only branch existence, then retain traversal, turning and endpoint constraints.
K11 path construction: derive the odd one-form from the supplied radial/azimuthal momentum quadratic by Hessian/inversion; project through the existing Jet grades.
Change NONRECIPROCITY_PATH_DEPENDENCE from Eq(curl,0) to Ne(curl,0), and form NONRECIPROCITY_PRIMITIVE from the retained beta rather than the untruncated beta.
Extract radar logarithmic support from the endpoint-dilation derivative leading degree instead of the radial exponent inventory; emit local dilation-grade tags.
Compute the coordinate sphere Jacobian and angular integral instead of inserting r**2 as the radial volume factor.
Split ordinary condition output from implied-exchange output into separate CONDITION and EXCHANGE tags/export roots.
For restrictions and forward outputs, print full retained deflection and a separate DEFLECTION_COMPARISON grade sum.
Add positive local bulk-number-density predicates to nonconstant Part C response domains.
Evaluate zero flux before exponent reparameterization in forward observable payloads using a Piecewise branch.
